claim: SoWLoader loads external mod DLLs from <install>\mods\ in filename order and calls an optional exported SoWMod_Init(int page) on its worker thread, with optional SoWMod_Name/SoWMod_Scope exports and a versioned HagUI_GetAPI ABI.
game_build_compatibility: Framework code itself is build-independent; mods that use shared/GameOffsets.h are not.
limitations: No dependency/ordering beyond filename sort; no isolation between mods.
next_experiment: None needed for the framework; decide whether Project Mordor writes its own loader or reuses this design pattern (license permitting).
